sloka: पुत्रान् चिर गतान् ज्ञात्वा सगरो रघुनंदन ।नप्तारम् अब्रवीत् राजा दीप्यमानम् स्व तेजसा ॥१-४१-१॥
transliteration: putrān cira gatān jñātvā sagaro raghunaṁdana ।naptāram abravīt rājā dīpyamānam sva tejasā ॥1-41-1॥

translations.english: "O Delight of the Raghus, king Sagara, realising that his sons had left long ago said to his grandson Anshuman resplendent with his own lustre:
